description: This Java source file defines the ContentBoxesController class which manages web requests related to content boxes in an admin interface, including listing, creating, viewing, and saving content box data within a Spring MVC web application.

classes.name: ContentBoxesController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling administrative operations for content boxes, such as listing, creation, editing, and saving content box entities.

methods.name: listContentBoxes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all content boxes, sets the menu, and returns the content page view.

methods.name: createBox
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize a new content box for creation, setting default descriptions and positions.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display details of a specific content box by ID, validating store ownership and content type.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a content box entity, including language processing and validation.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items in the model for UI menu highlighting.
